description.value: The study combined behavioral testing with structural and resting-state imaging in bvFTD patients and age-matched controls, and task-based functional imaging in young healthy volunteers to investigate dissociations between emotion detection and categorization.

description.value: A mixed study with bvFTD patients and age-matched controls undergoing behavioral, structural and resting-state imaging, and young healthy volunteers undergoing task-based functional imaging.

name.value: emotion detection gray matter volume correlation

definition.value: Gray matter volume correlated with emotion detection ambiguity points.

value: Gray matter volume in the left anterior temporal lobe correlated significantly with emotion detection ambiguity points in bvFTD patients; the more sensitive a patient was in detecting an emotion, the less atrophy his or her left anterior temporal lobe showed.

name.value: emotion categorization gray matter volume correlation

definition.value: Gray matter volume correlated with emotion categorization ambiguity points.

value: Gray matter volume in the left opercular inferior frontal gyrus correlated significantly with emotion categorization ambiguity points in bvFTD patients; the more sensitive a patient was in identifying the emotion, the less atrophic his or her inferior frontal gyrus was.

name.value: left ATL resting state connectivity group comparison

definition.value: Reduced connectivity between the left ATL and the rest of the brain in bvFTD patients compared with controls.

value: Connectivity between the left anterior temporal lobe and mid- and posterior temporal cortex, inferior frontal gyrus, and medial orbitofrontal cortex was significantly reduced in bvFTD patients compared with controls, after controlling for gray matter atrophy.

spans.text: Finally, Fischer's z‐transformed connectivity maps were normalized to MNI space using DARTEL and smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 6 mm FWHM.

name.value: left IFG resting state connectivity group comparison

definition.value: Reduced connectivity of the left IFG in bvFTD patients compared with controls.

value: Connectivity of the left inferior frontal gyrus with the contralateral anterior insula, contralateral amygdala, and contralateral anterior temporal lobe was significantly reduced in bvFTD patients compared with controls, after controlling for gray matter atrophy.

spans.text: Finally, Fischer's z‐transformed connectivity maps were normalized to MNI space using DARTEL and smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 6 mm FWHM.

value: Both the anterior temporal lobe and inferior frontal gyrus contained information that reliably discriminated emotional from neutral stimuli in healthy volunteers.

definition.value: Classification of four emotions from multivoxel response patterns.

spans.text: These regions showed reliable brain‐behavior correlations between fMRI activation and sensitivity for emotion categorization in a group of 16 young, healthy volunteers.

value: The anterior temporal lobe did not classify the four emotions significantly above chance, whereas classification in the inferior frontal gyrus was highly significant. Thus, only the inferior frontal gyrus contained information sufficient to categorize the four emotions.
